observation.visible_scene: A close-up of flickering orange-yellow flames set against a solid black background, accompanied by a few small glowing ember particles floating above the fire.
visible_changes: The flame body continuously deforms rather than moving as a rigid object: its tongues stretch, curl, split and re-merge. Early frames show a tall plume leaning to the right; by the mid-frames (≈t=0.48–0.84) the mass is more centered with a broad horizontal curling cap; in the late frames (≈t=1.36–1.60) it contracts into a lower, narrower cluster near the bottom-center.

Several small embers drift upward and toward the right edge. The bright ember near the top-right at t=0 rises to the top border by t=0.36–0.44 and fades, while other specks similarly climb and dim over the sequence.

The base of the flame stays roughly at the bottom-center throughout; no consistent pan, tilt or zoom is discernible against the featureless black backdrop, so the apparent motion is the fire's own flicker and the rising embers, not camera movement.
Overall brightness and flame height fluctuate from frame to frame (e.g., a taller, brighter column around t=0.56–0.72 versus a shorter, dimmer one at the start and end).
outside_clip_unknowns: The fuel or source feeding the fire, the cause of ignition, and any outcome after the last frame are not visible.
Whether the segment begins or ends mid-burn cannot be determined; both crop boundaries are arbitrary.
uncertain_details: The slight leftward/rightward shift of the flame's center of mass is hard to separate from pure shape deformation.
True camera motion cannot be confirmed or ruled out because the black background offers no parallax reference.
